concept.hr: Parovi dioda provode naizmjence; struja kroz trošilo teče u istom smjeru
concept.en: Two diode pairs take turns; the current through the load always flows one way

summary.hr: Transformator i četiri diode u mostu: u svakoj poluperiodi provode dvije diode u nizu, a negativna poluperioda izlazi okrenuta.
summary.en: A transformer and four diodes in a bridge: in each half-period two diodes in series conduct, and the negative half-wave comes out flipped.

what.hr: Aplet applet_gleichrichter_2.html (mosni ispravljač, obje poluperiode odvojeno) i njegove slike 962, 963 i 964 (50ohm.de, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The applet applet_gleichrichter_2.html (the bridge rectifier, both half-periods separately) and its figures 962, 963 and 964 (50ohm.de, Croatian translation)

credits.by: 50ohm.de-Autorenteam, AJW-Referat des DARC e.V. (figures: Dr. Matthias Jung, DL9MJ)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu, slike ponovno nacrtane kao SVG, tekst preveden na engleski, gumbi postali koraci i predlošci, dodani korak s obje poluperiode, imena dioda, pregled stanja dioda i objašnjenje
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit, the figures redrawn as SVG, the text translated into English, the buttons turned into steps and presets, a step with both half-periods, diode names, a summary of the diodes' states and an explanation added
